description: Dependency updates as pull requests, once a month, for releases at least two weeks old. Runs only once the repository owner has installed the Renovate GitHub app.

pip_requirements.description: backend/constraints.txt pins every Python package (pip install -c).

nvm.description: Node.js (.nvmrc) moves by hand, with package.json's engines, scripts/workflow.mjs and the CI matrix.

pyenv.description: Python (.python-version) moves by hand, with the CI matrix and backend/pyproject.toml's requires-python.

packageRules.description: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists the npm and Python packages with their versions, so CI's notices check fails until it is regenerated on the branch.
prBodyNotes: 의존성이 바뀌면 CI의 `npm run notices:check`가 실패합니다. 이 브랜치에서 `npm ci`, `npm run setup:python` 뒤 `npm run notices`를 실행해 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md를 갱신하고 커밋하세요.

packageRules.description: Python pins (backend/constraints.txt) and ranges (backend/pyproject.toml) in one pull request: pip refuses a pin outside its range.
Playwright of the E2E tests (npm) and of the backend (pinned in backend/pyproject.toml and backend/constraints.txt) in one pull request: the backend needs the Chromium build of its own release.
Electron and electron-builder change the packaged exe: build it on Windows and check what tests/package.test.cjs names before merging.
Next.js and React with their types.
Node.js types follow the oldest Node.js the project supports (engines, .nvmrc).
The actions of .github/workflows, pinned to commits.
